examples.en: We have English class in the morning.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We have English class. class 是课、班级。

examples.en: Hurry up, or you'll be late.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：hurry 赶快 + up 向上，hurry up 是快点、赶快。
语义联想：Don't be late. late 是迟到、晚的。
语义联想：Are you ready? ready 是准备好的。
语义联想：I'm sorry. sorry 表示对不起、抱歉。

examples.en: Our classroom is big and bright.
examples.zh: 我们的教室又大又明亮。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：class 课 + room 房间，classroom 是教室。

examples.en: The classroom light is too bright.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Turn on the light. light 是灯、灯光。
语义联想：Follow the rules. rule 是规则、规章。
拆词联想：turn 转 + off 关，turn off 是关掉（灯、风扇等）。

examples.en: The teacher writes on the blackboard.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：black 黑 + board 板，blackboard 是黑板。

examples.en: The chair is next to the desk.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 chair 椅子摆在课桌旁边。

examples.en: Put your books on the desk.
My desk is near the window.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 desk 课桌上放着课本和铅笔盒。

definitions.text: 整洁的；整齐的；使整洁；整理

examples.zh: 我们一起把教室整理干净吧。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Keep your desk tidy. tidy 是整洁的；整理。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 tidies；过去式 tidied

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：door 门，音近「多」，多问一句 door 在哪。
形象联想：想象 push 或 pull door 门进出教室。

examples.en: Turn on the fan. It's hot.
The fan is on the wall.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：fan 风扇，音近「番」，夏天多开几番 fan 才凉快。
形象联想：想象 fan 风扇在墙上呼呼转。

examples.en: We have music class on Friday.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We have music class. music 是音乐。

examples.en: My desk is by the window.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 window 窗外有阳光照进来。

examples.en: The teacher hands out the books.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：hand 手 + out 出去，hand out 是分发、发下去。

examples.en: I read a newspaper at home.
There is a newspaper on the desk.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：news 新闻 + paper 纸，newspaper 是报纸。

examples.en: I don't understand. Can you help me?
examples.zh: 我不明白，你能帮帮我吗？

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：under 在…下 + stand 站，understand 是理解、明白。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 understands；过去式 understood

examples.en: There is a fan on the wall.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 wall 墙上挂着钟和风扇。

examples.en: When do we have music class?
examples.zh: 我们什么时候上音乐课？

examples.en: When you are ready, raise your hand.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：When do we have class? when 是什么时候。

examples.en: Write the words in your workbook.
examples.zh: 把单词写在你的练习册里。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：work 练习 + book 书，workbook 是练习册。
语义联想：Do homework first. first 是第一、首先。

examples.en: I finish my homework before dinner.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：home 家 + work 工作，homework 是家庭作业。

examples.en: We watch TV in the living room.
The living room is big and bright.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：living 生活 + room 房间，living room 是客厅。

examples.en: Don't run on the wet floor.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Don't run in the house. run 是跑。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 runs；过去式 ran

examples.en: Follow the rules to stay safe.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：It's safe here. safe 是安全的。

examples.en: We watch TV in the living room.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 TV 电视屏幕在客厅亮着。
语义联想：Don't watch TV too late. watch 是观看。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 watches；过去式 watched

examples.en: The floor is wet. Don't run.
My hair is wet after a shower.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The floor is wet. wet 是湿的、潮的。

examples.en: You are very helpful at home.
It's helpful to tidy your room.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：help 帮助 + ful，helpful 是有帮助的。

examples.en: I wash my face every morning.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Wash your hands. wash 是洗。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 washes；过去式 washed

examples.en: Write the new word five times.
I learn a new word every day.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Write the new word. word 是单词。
拆词联想：bed 床 + room 房间，bedroom 是卧室。

examples.en: Mum is cooking in the kitchen.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：kit 成套器具 + chen 音近，kitchen 是厨房。

examples.en: Don't talk so loud at home.
examples.zh: 别在家里这么大声说话。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Don't talk so loud. loud 是大声的。
语义联想：Go to sleep early. sleep 是睡觉。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 sleeps；过去式 slept

examples.en: Wash your hands in the bathroom.
The bathroom is next to my bedroom.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：bath 洗澡 + room 房间，bathroom 是卫生间。

examples.en: I do my homework in the study.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I do homework in the study. study 是书房；也可作学习。
语义联想：How do you feel? feel 是觉得、感到。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 feels；过去式 felt

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Follow the rules. follow 是遵循、跟随。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 follows；过去式 followed

examples.en: Work hard and you will do well.
My parents work hard for our family.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Work hard. hard 是努力地；困难的。

examples.en: I think this rule is good.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Think before you answer. think 是认为、思考。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 thinks；过去式 thought

definitions.text: （花费时间和精力）做（某事）；工作

examples.en: My parents work hard every day.
examples.zh: 我父母每天都很努力工作。

examples.en: I work on my homework after school.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：My parents work hard. work 是工作；也可作动词。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 works；过去式 worked

examples.en: We have dinner at six o'clock.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We have dinner at six. dinner 是正餐、晚饭。

examples.en: The kid is reading a book.
Every kid should follow the rules.
examples.zh: 每个孩子都应该遵守规则。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The kid is reading. kid 是小孩、儿童。

examples.en: School is over at four o'clock.
Class is over. Let's go home.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：School is over. over 可表示结束、完了。

examples.en: We have art class on Wednesday.
I like art class very much.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We have art class. art 是美术、艺术。
语义联想：It's time for lunch. lunch 是午餐。

examples.en: We have maths in the morning.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We have maths in the morning. maths 是数学。

examples.en: I get up at seven o'clock.
When do you get up every day?

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：get 起来 + up 向上，get up 是起床。

examples.en: I go to school at eight o'clock.
We go to school from Monday to Friday.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：go 去 + to school 学校，go to school 是上学。

examples.en: We go home at four o'clock.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：go 去 + home 家，go home 是回家。

examples.en: I go to bed at nine o'clock.
Go to bed early. You have school tomorrow.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：go 去 + to bed 床，go to bed 是上床睡觉。

examples.en: Look at the clock. It's eight o'clock.
There is a clock on the wall.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 clock 钟表指针指向上课时间。
语义联想：It's just seven o'clock. just 是正好、仅仅。
语义联想：Wait a minute. minute 是分钟。

examples.en: I want to play after school.
What do you want for lunch?

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I want to play. want 是想要。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 wants；过去式 wanted

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：These clothes are nice. clothes 是衣服、服装。
形象联想：想象 shorts 短裤到膝盖上面。
语义联想：Those shorts are cheap. those 是那些。

examples.en: I want a pair of trousers.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 trousers 长裤从腰穿到脚。

examples.en: I want to buy a new jacket.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 jacket 夹克外套扣上扣子。
形象联想：想象 skirt 短裙随风轻轻摆。

谐音联想：Dear 写信开头像叫「爹啊」，dear 是亲爱的；也指贵的。
语义联想：Dear Mum, this hat is for you. dear 是亲爱的（也可指贵的）。
语义联想：This jacket is too expensive. expensive 是昂贵的。

examples.en: Take your size and try them on.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：take 表示「买下」，结合本课例句记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 takes；过去式 took

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：beauty 美 + ful，beautiful 是美丽的。

examples.en: I like cheap and nice clothes.
examples.zh: 我喜欢又便宜又好看的衣服。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：These shorts are cheap. cheap 是便宜的。

examples.en: I want to buy a hat.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：hat 帽子，音近「害特」，大太阳下戴 hat 才不「害」怕晒。
形象联想：想象 hat 帽子戴在头上遮阳。

谐音联想：shoe 鞋，音近「舒」，穿 shoe 走路才舒服。
形象联想：想象 shoe 鞋子穿在脚上走路。

examples.en: I wear sunglasses on sunny days.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：sun 太阳 + glasses 眼镜，sunglasses 是太阳镜。

examples.en: Do you have any cheap hats?

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Do you have any hats? any 是任何的、一些。

谐音联想：free 免费，音近「飞」，免费的东西像飞来的好事。
语义联想：These sunglasses are free. free 是免费的。

definitions.text: （服装、食物、日用品等）大型号的

examples.en: This jacket is too large for me.
Do you have a large size?

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：This jacket is too large. large 是大的。
语义联想：Make a shopping list. list 是清单、列表。

examples.en: These shoes are the right size.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：What size do you wear? size 是尺码、尺寸。

examples.en: Can I try on this jacket?
examples.zh: 我可以试穿这件夹克吗？

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：try 试 + on 穿上，try on 是试穿。

examples.en: We have a chicken on the farm.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 chicken 鸡在鸡窝里下蛋。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 chickens（作「鸡」）；鸡肉不可数

examples.en: There is a cow on the farm.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：cow 奶牛，音近「考」，农场里的 cow 考你认不认识它。
形象联想：想象 cow 奶牛在农场里吃草。

examples.en: I see a horse on the farm.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 horse 马在田野里奔跑。

examples.en: The pig is pink and fat.
We feed the pig every day.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 pig 猪在猪圈里哼哼叫。

examples.en: There are many sheep on the farm.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 sheep 绵羊身上毛茸茸的。

谐音联想：bee 听音像「比」，蜜蜂嗡嗡比着谁采蜜快。
语义联想：The bee makes honey. bee 是蜜蜂。

examples.en: This tomato is red and big.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 tomato 番茄又红又圆。

examples.en: This carrot is long and orange.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 carrot 胡萝卜是橙色的长条。

examples.en: I see a mouse in the field.
examples.zh: 我在田地里看见一只老鼠。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 mouse 老鼠小小一只跑得快。

examples.en: We grow a potato on the farm.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 potato 土豆埋在土里挖出来。

examples.en: I want a box of tomatoes.
She buys a box of crayons.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：a box 一盒 + of ……的，a box of 是一盒、一箱。

examples.en: There is a can on the table.
Put the beans in a can.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：There is a can on the table. can 这里是金属罐。

examples.en: We pick green beans in the garden.
examples.zh: 我们在菜园里摘四季豆。

examples.en: Green beans are good for you.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：green 绿 + bean 豆，green bean 是四季豆。

examples.en: We feed the chickens every morning.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We feed the chickens. feed 是喂养、饲养。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 feeds；过去式 fed

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Pass me the spoon. pass 是给、递、传递。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 passes；过去式 passed

examples.en: I'd like a glass of milk.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I'd like a glass of milk. milk 是牛奶；也可作动词挤奶。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 milks；过去式 milked（作动词挤奶）

examples.en: We pick vegetables on the farm.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Pick up your chopsticks. pick 是摘、拾、选。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 picks；过去式 picked

examples.en: Pick up your chopstick before dinner.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：chop 砍 + stick 棍，chopstick 是筷子。

examples.en: Please clear the table after dinner.
I clear the table every evening.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：clear 清理 + the table 餐桌，clear the table 是收拾餐桌。
拆词联想：delight 愉悦 + ous，delicious 是美味的。
语义联想：The food is delicious. food 是食物。

examples.en: I eat salad with a fork.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 fork 叉子叉起沙拉。

examples.en: Use a knife and fork, please.
The knife is on the right.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 knife 刀和 fork 叉一起摆在桌上。
语义联想：Don't waste food. waste 是浪费。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 wastes；过去式 wasted

examples.en: I eat soup from a bowl.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：bowl 碗，音近「抱」，双手 bowl 着碗喝汤。
形象联想：想象 bowl 碗里盛着热汤。

examples.en: Please set the table for dinner.
examples.zh: 请摆好餐桌准备吃晚饭。

examples.en: She sets the table every evening.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：set 摆放 + the table 餐桌，set the table 是摆餐具。
形象联想：想象 spoon 勺子舀起一勺汤。

definitions.text: （用作女性的反身代词）她自己，自己

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：her 她 + self 自己，herself 是她自己。

examples.en: This salad is fresh and delicious.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 salad 沙拉里有蔬菜颜色丰富。

examples.en: We buy food at the supermarket.
The supermarket is near my home.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：super 超级 + market 市场，supermarket 是超市。

examples.en: We go to the supermarket once a week.
I have art class twice a week.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：week 星期，音近「喂克」，一周 week 喂饱七天。
语义联想：We go once a week. week 是星期、周。
